suites.title: Software development
suites.description: Ten real engineering problems, two per lane: design, code, test, review and fix. Judge-scored 0-100.

suites.title: Recall
suites.description: Closed-book memory of exact public-domain text, speeches and music: how much is right, how much is invented, and whether the model knows which.

suites.title: Strange machine
suites.description: A model designs, builds and programs its own one-instruction computer: requirements and design, then an emulator and assembler in Rust, then a ladder of programs on it.
